title: Software Test Engineer
description:
WritingJob Description: Software Test Engineer / QA EngineerJob Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and quality-driven **Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer** to ensure the functionality, reliability, security, and performance of enterprise software applications. The candidate will collaborate with developers, technical leads, product teams, business analysts, and UI/UX designers to identify defects, validate application workflows, improve test coverage, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

The role involves manual testing, API testing, database validation, test automation, performance testing, and software quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities1. Manual and Functional Testing

* Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate application workflows, user interfaces, forms, reports, and business rules.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Ensure test coverage across positive, negative, boundary, and exception scenarios.
* Conduct GUI testing and backend testing to verify application functionality and data accuracy.
* Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) support and release validation.

2. API and Database Testing

* Test REST APIs using Postman or similar API testing tools.
* Validate API requests, responses, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL.
* Verify data consistency, integrity, and accuracy across application modules.
* Test integrations with third-party applications and enterprise systems.
* Identify API and database-related issues and coordinate with development teams for resolution.

3. Test Automation

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks.
* Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases to improve testing efficiency.
* Maintain reusable test scripts and automation frameworks.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation based on application requirements and testing priorities.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
* Collaborate with developers to improve test coverage and reduce manual testing effort.

4. Performance, Security, and Quality Assurance

* Support performance and load testing using JMeter or similar tools.
* Evaluate application responsiveness, stability, and performance under different workloads.
* Validate authentication, authorization, access controls, and session management.
* Identify potential application security vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation with development teams.
* Apply relevant security testing practices, including awareness of the OWASP Top 10.
* Participate in defect triage, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality assessment documentation.

5. Team Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, technical leads, and UI/UX designers.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and sprint retrospectives.
* Support UAT, production validation, and release testing activities.
* Maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, defect logs, and other QA documentation.
* Track testing progress and communicate risks, blockers, and quality concerns to stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and quality standards.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in software testing or quality assurance; the stated experience range is **2–7 years**, subject to confirmation.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
* Hands-on experience in manual, functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Practical experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Knowledge of SQL and database testing, preferably with PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Understanding of defect tracking, test documentation, and root-cause analysis.
* Knowledge of performance testing, security testing, and CI/CD workflows is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing activities.

Required Technical Skills

* **Manual Testing:** Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, Sanity, End-to-End, GUI, and Backend Testing
* **API Testing:** Postman, REST APIs, Request/Response Validation, Authentication, and Authorization
* **Database Testing:** SQL, PostgreSQL, Data Validation, and Data Integrity
* **Automation Testing:** Selenium, Playwright, Cypress
* **Performance Testing:** JMeter, Load Testing, and Performance Testing
* **Security Testing:** Access Control Validation, Session Management, and OWASP Top 10 Awareness
* **Programming Languages:** Python, Java, JavaScript
* **Development Tools:** Git, Docker, CI/CD
* **Test Management:** Jira, Defect Tracking, Test Case Design, and Test Documentation
* **Methodologies:** SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, UAT, and Root Cause Analysis

Job Details

* **Job Title:** Software Test Engineer / QA Engineer
* **Experience:** 2–7 Years (to be confirmed)
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
* **Job Domain:** Software Testing and Quality Assurance
* **Core Focus:** Manual Testing, API Testing, Database Testing, Automation, Performance, and Security
* **Work Environment:** Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, and technical teams

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Clearwater Analytics**
==============================

Clearwater Analytics is a global SaaS leader in automated investment data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting. Serving the world's largest asset managers, insurance companies, and corporations, Clearwater processes trillions of dollars in assets daily. Our Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform delivers real-time risk analytics and pricing intelligence — powered by reliable, high-quality market data and reference data pipelines at the core.

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform team. In this role you will design, build, and operate mission-critical market data and reference data pipelines that feed our real-time pricing and risk engines. You will work closely with quant researchers, data vendors, and platform engineers to ensure that high-quality, low-latency data flows reliably across the entire investment analytics stack.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will make architectural decisions, mentor peers, and directly influence how Clearwater ingests, normalises, and distributes market data at scale.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Market & Reference Data Pipelines**
-------------------------------------

* Design and build scalable Python-based ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting multi-asset market data (equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX, commodities) from vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG, ICE Data Services, and FactSet.
* Engineer and maintain a robust securities master (reference data) system covering identifiers (CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI), corporate actions, instrument attributes, and classification hierarchies.
* Build real-time and batch data feeds using AWS-native services (Kinesis, MSK/Kafka, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions) with SLAs measured in milliseconds to seconds.
* Implement data quality frameworks — completeness checks, anomaly detection, stale-data alerting, and automated reconciliation against authoritative vendor sources.

**Platform & Infrastructure**
-----------------------------

* Architect cloud-native, event-driven data infrastructure on AWS (S3, Redshift, RDS Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache) with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CDK).
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and ensure deployments are automated, tested, and observable (CloudWatch, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
* Drive schema design, data modelling, and partitioning strategies that balance query performance against storage cost at petabyte scale.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years building production data pipelines in Python (Pandas, PySpark, asyncio, or equivalent).
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis / MSK, Redshift, RDS, Step Functions.
* Strong understanding of market data domains — pricing, corporate actions, identifier mapping, instrument reference data — from a financial services or fintech context.
* Experience designing and operating high-availability, low-latency streaming and batch pipelines in production.
* Proficiency in SQL and data modelling for analytical and operational workloads.
* Familiarity with data quality patterns: schema validation, reconciliation, SLA monitoring, dead-letter queues, and alerting.
* Strong communication skills — you write clear design docs, run productive tech discussions, and collaborate across disciplines.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with securities master / reference data systems: CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, and corporate action processing.
* Prior integration with major market data vendors (Bloomberg B-PIPE / SAPI, Refinitiv/LSEG Elektron, ICE Data Services).
* Knowledge of Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or other open table formats for data lake management.
* Familiarity with risk or pricing platforms in asset management or insurance investment operations.
* AWS Professional or Specialty certifications (Data Analytics, Solutions Architect).

* Build a foundation in a strategic Synopsys product line at the center of the industry shift toward chiplet-based systems.

* **15+** years of relevant software or R&D experience.
* Strong C/C++ skills and a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity.

* Interest in physical design, EDA, semiconductors, or advanced packaging — prior domain experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Coursework or project experience in at least one related area is helpful: graph algorithms, computational geometry, CAD/EDA tools, VLSI/physical design, or large-scale C++ software.

You will join the advanced packaging design automation team for 3DIC Compiler. Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more efficiently. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Job Duties:**

We are seeking a motivated and quick-to-learn Software Engineer to join the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) field, specifically to advance the Questa formal verification product family. In this multifaceted role, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle, from writing functional specifications to designing algorithms, coding, and creating test plans. Collaboration with a team of talented engineers and supporting top-tier industry customers will be essential.

The ideal candidate will have extensive software development experience, particularly in developing and customizing components around graph-based formal models, with hands-on programming and expertise in crafting efficient netlist representation models for formal applications.

Our primary responsibilities will include crafting and developing new features, customizing existing solutions, and improving software components for formal verification, ensuring quality, scalability, modifiability, and testability. You will collaborate with other engineering teams, take ownership of specific components, and drive them to excellence. Additionally, you will help drive the best software practices within the team and mentor other specialists as needed, all while contributing to the business’s overall needs.

* We require candidates to have a BE/B-Tech/M.Tech in CSE/ECE from a reputed engineering college.

* We are looking for candidates with 25 years of software experience, preferably in the Design and Verification domain.

* Expert in **C++**, design patterns, and algorithms.

* Strong understanding of **data structures** and **algorithm complexities**.

* Proficient in advanced **data structures** and their applications.

* Expert in one of the following hardware description languages: **Verilog**, **System Verilog**, or **VHDL**.

* Knowledge of scripting languages like **Perl**, **Python**, **Bash**, or **Tcl**.

* Proficient with development tools such as **Makefile**, **gdb**, **valgrind**, **perforce/git**, **gcov**, **editors**, and **IDEs**.

* Strong **problem-solving** and **analytical skills**.

* Experienced in the **development and delivery** of multi-man-month projects from start to finish.

* Familiarity with **Linux platforms**.

* Exposure to **formal-based verification methodologies** (model checking, equivalence checking, automated reasoning) is a plus.

**Soft Skills:**

* Self-motivated and committed to work.

* Strong team player with the ability to work independently.

* Hardworking, sincere, and open to constructive feedback.

* Able to work in challenging environments and collaborate effectively with multi-cultural technical teams.

* Exposure to Synthesis, Simulation, and other verification methodologies like Assertion, Coverage, etc.

**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**

  

**The Team**

Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.

Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.

We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.

  
  

**The Impact**

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.

The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
